name: Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy Rehabilitation Protocol
description: Evidence-based 12-week protocol for rotator cuff tendinopathy with progressive load increase
pain_rule: Pain max. 3/10 during the exercise. Overhead movements only when pain-free.
evidence_base: Littlewood et al. (2015): Exercise superior to surgery for rotator cuff tendinopathy
Lewis (2016): Rotator cuff tendinopathy clinical practice guidelines
Cools et al. (2014): Rehabilitation of scapular dyskinesis
Kuhn et al. (2009): Progressive resistance training for rotator cuff
progression_criteria: Pain-free shoulder movement up to 90 degrees abduction
External rotation against resistance without pain
No more night pain or resting pain

exercises.name: Isometric External Rotation
exercises.description: Standing with elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees. Push outward against a door frame or wall
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and rotator cuff activation

exercises.name: Isometric Abduction
exercises.description: Standing, push arm sideways against wall at 30 degrees abduction. Actively pull shoulder blade back and down
exercises.phase_goal: Pain reduction and rotator cuff activation

exercises.name: External Rotation with Band
exercises.description: Elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees. Slowly pull band outward and return with control

exercises.name: Scaption (Arm Raise in Scapular Plane)
exercises.description: Standing, raise arm 30 degrees in front of the frontal plane up to shoulder height. Thumb pointing up

exercises.name: Prone Y-Raise
exercises.description: Prone position, raise arms in Y-position. Squeeze shoulder blades together and hold

exercises.name: Eccentric External Rotation
exercises.description: With band or cable: assume external rotation position, then slowly and controlled let it return
exercises.phase_goal: Functional load tolerance and overhead tolerance

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Light)
exercises.description: Shoulder press with light weight. Only if pain-free overhead movement is possible
exercises.phase_goal: Functional load tolerance and overhead tolerance
